title: Finite restriction arrows and triangles lift at one refinement
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and put $I=(i\downarrow J)$; for $t\in I$ write $v_t=V_{t.right}$ and $f_t=F(t.hom)$. Fix $t\in I$, $U\in F(t.right)$, finite sets $\alpha$ and $\epsilon$, objects $W_q\in F(t.right)$ for $q\in\alpha$, and arrows $f_q:v_t(U)\to v_t(W_q)$. Give maps $s,d:\epsilon\to\alpha$ and arrows $a_e:W_{s(e)}\to W_{d(e)}$ with $f_{s(e)}v_t(a_e)=f_{d(e)}$. Fix $q_0\in\alpha$, an equality $W_{q_0}=U$, and assume $f_{q_0}$ is the identity transported along that equality. Then there are $r\in I$, $b:t\to r$, and arrows $g_q:F(b.right)(U)\to F(b.right)(W_q)$ such that $g_{s(e)}F(b.right)(a_e)=g_{d(e)}$ for all $e\in\epsilon$, and $g_{q_0}$ is the identity transported along $F(b.right)(W_{q_0})=F(b.right)(U)$.

proof.text: Reuse the proved private lift_arrow from ColimitSiteRawSectionGenerators through a proof-only import all. It lifts a restriction arrow and aligns both prescribed endpoints at a common stage. The local lift_same_stage_arrow helper then equalizes the two arrows out of t.right to obtain a single refinement in Under i.

Apply that construction to every member of the finite object family. IsFiltered.wideSpan synchronizes all refinements b_q to one b. Transport the lifted arrows along F.map_comp; cocone naturality proves their images are f_q.

The prescribed triangles and base identity have equal Arrow images; reuse arrow_comp_congr from FilteredColimitFiniteIsoLift for the triangles. Apply its proved finite_stage_eq helper to the arrow-colimit family indexed by epsilon plus Unit. Functor.congr_hom transports the resulting equations to the composite refinement. Both existing private helpers are accessed through a proof-only import all, with no duplicate declarations.

theorem colimit_site_finite_restriction_family_lift
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F) (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (i : J) (t : Under i) (U : F.obj t.right)
    {α ε : Type u} [Finite α] [Finite ε]
    (W : α → F.obj t.right)
    (f : ∀ q, (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj U ⟶
      (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj (W q))
    (src dst : ε → α) (a : ∀ e, W (src e) ⟶ W (dst e))
    (hf : ∀ e, f (src e) ≫ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map (a e) = f (dst e))
    (q₀ : α) (hW : W q₀ = U)
    (h₀ : f q₀ = eqToHom (congrArg (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj hW.symm)) :
    ∃ (r : Under i) (b : t ⟶ r)
      (g : ∀ q, (F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj U ⟶
        (F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj (W q)),
      (∀ e, g (src e) ≫ (F.map b.right).toFunctor.map (a e) = g (dst e)) ∧
      g q₀ = eqToHom (congrArg (F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj hW.symm)
